settings.title: Frequently asked questions
settings.text: Delivery, care, returns and everything in between — the answers to the questions our customers ask most.

settings.question: How does white-glove delivery work?
settings.answer: Our delivery partners call you 24 hours in advance to schedule a 2-hour window. They bring the pieces inside, place them in the room, assemble anything requiring tools, and take all packaging away with them.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: In-stock pieces dispatch within 3–7 business days. Handcrafted and small-batch pieces show their lead time on the product page. You'll receive tracking details by email once your order is on its way.

settings.question: How should I clean and maintain the cane webbing?
settings.answer: Dust with a soft, dry cloth. Twice a year, wipe it lightly with a damp cloth and mild soap to keep the natural rattan fibres supple. Avoid soaking, and keep cane away from radiators and direct heating vents.

settings.question: How do I care for the solid wood frame?
settings.answer: Wipe with a soft, dry cloth. Use coasters to avoid water rings, and keep furniture out of prolonged direct sunlight to prevent the finish from fading unevenly.

settings.question: Do you make custom sizes or finishes?
settings.answer: Because our batches are small and handcrafted, we keep our catalogue fixed. However, if you're outfitting an entire room, reach out to our studio team for bespoke options.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: You have 30 days from delivery to return a piece for a full refund or exchange, provided it's in its original condition. Custom or made-to-order pieces are non-refundable unless faulty.

settings.question: Does the furniture require assembly?
settings.answer: Most pieces arrive fully assembled. Where legs need attaching, our white-glove team does it on delivery — a two-person job with tools included, so you never lift a screwdriver.

settings.question: What warranty do you offer?
settings.answer: Every piece carries a 1-year structural warranty against manufacturing defects. This covers frames and joinery — not normal wear and tear or accidental damage.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: Once your order ships, we'll email you a tracking link. You can also check order status any time using the Track Your Order page.
